note: City of Marble Falls, TX. INSTRUMENT: Code of Ordinances App. B Development Code (UDC), Art. 4 -- Table 4.2.2 (residential building types), Table 4.2.6.A (Downtown Residential), Table 4.2.7.A (Existing Neighborhood Zone sub-districts), Table 4.3.1.B (nonresidential and mixed-use) and Sec. 4.3.4 (Downtown build-to lines). EDITION: "Codified through Ordinance No. 2026-O-04A, adopted April 7, 2026. (Supp. No. 98)". Adopting ordinance: Ord. No. 2018-O-10A (adopted 2018-10-23). Amendments: 2019-O-05A, 2020-O-03D, 2021-O-07B, 2022-O-06A and 2025-O-08C (2025-08-05, amends Sec. 4.2.2). Sec. 4.3.4 is unchanged since 2018-O-10A. SOURCE: library.municode.com (linked from marblefallstx.gov), read by the operator's browser agent on 2026-10-12 (doc_repo/_inbox/2026-10-13_burnet_B3_groundtruth_browser_packE.csv, "pack E"); every table value was checked by script against the live Municode tables. This replaces the earlier zoneomics-mirror transcription (W1-H), which LDT #805 downgraded to unverified. SCOPE: 7 of the 17 stamped districts -- ENZ.1, ENZ.2, ENZ.3, ENZ.4, ENZ.5, BP, IN. The other 10 stay UNROWED and refuse SETBACK_CONDITIONAL_NOT_EVALUATED in the register: FR, RE, NR, TR and MR (Table 4.2.2 gives one row per building type, marks none as primary, and the district has several Single-Family Detached rows with different numbers -- or, for MR, none); DR (Table 4.2.6.A keys every building type to a lot-width tier whose numbers differ); NC and GC (side/rear change for lots adjacent to Lake Marble Falls, Table 4.3.1.B note 1); DN and DT (build-to lines, lake-adjacent side/rear, plus townhouse rows). PD stays unverified (pack E did not extract Div. 4.4). BUILDING-TYPE RULE: a district is served only when its governing table gives it exactly one Single-Family Detached row (or only one row at all); that row is served and every other row is quoted in the register. ENZ.3/ENZ.4/ENZ.5 serve their single Single-Family Detached row; ENZ.1, ENZ.2, BP and IN have one row each. READING RULES: Table 4.2.7.B's alternate standards (front setback averaging, front-porch reduction, street-side averaging) are optional reductions from the stated figure, so the stated figure is coded and the alternates are quoted in front_ft's provenance. No Marble Falls table states an impervious-cover figure, so max_impervious_pct is not_specified everywhere (never read as zero). SENTINELS: not_specified = 100, except max_height_ft's canonical 999 (no served row needs it). No code-section atom corpus exists yet for marble_falls_tx; every value is primary-source-verified.

front_ft.section_number: App. B Development Code, Art. 4, Table 4.2.7.A
front_ft.quote: App. B Development Code, Art. 4, Table 4.2.7.A -- front setback (district "ENZ.1", building-type row "N/A"): "50'". Table 4.2.7.B Alternate Lot and Building Standards (verbatim): Front Setback Averaging: The front setback may be reduced to the lesser of: The average front building setback of homes along the same side of the street within the same sub-district; or The average front building setback of homes within 500 feet, on either side, of the parcel proposed for development. Front Porches: The front setback for a front porch may be reduced by up to six feet so that the front porch is located no closer than 14 feet from the front property line and is only enclosed with screens (not walls and windows). Street Side Setback Averaging: The street side setback on any given lot may be reduced to no less than the average street side setback of lots within the same sub-district. Side-Loaded Garages: The front setback may be reduced by 10 feet to establish a side loaded garage provided that: 1) There is more than one side-loaded garage within the same sub-district; 2) The lot is at least 75 feet wide; 3) The reduction only applies to the garage; 4) The garage has at least one street-facing window; and 5) The garage is constructed of the same design features and exterior materials as the principal building. Rear-Loaded Garages: The rear setback for a rear-loaded garage taking access from an alley may be reduced to 7.5 feet.
